H5101.def: to bray (as an ass), scream (from hunger)

H5102.def: to sparkle, i.e. (figuratively) be cheerful; hence (from the sheen of a running stream) to flow, i.e. (figuratively) assemble

H5104.def: a stream (including the sea; expectation the Nile, Euphrates, etc.); figuratively, prosperity

H5106.gloss: break, disallow, discourage, make of none effect.
H5106.def: to refuse, forbid, dissuade, or neutralize

H5107.def: to germinate, i.e. (figuratively) to (causatively, make) flourish; also (of words), to utter

H5110.gloss: bemoan, flee, get, mourn, make to move, take pity, remove, shake, skip for joy, be sorry, vagabond, way, wandering.
H5110.def: to nod, i.e. waver; figuratively, to wander, flee, disappear; also (from shaking the head in sympathy), to console, deplore, or (from tossing the head in scorn) taunt

H5115.gloss: keept at home, prepare an habitation.
H5115.def: to rest (as at home); causatively (through the implied idea of beauty ), to celebrate (with praises)

H5116.gloss: comely, dwelling (place), fold, habitation, pleasant place, sheepcote, stable, tarried.
H5116.def: (adjectively) at home; hence (by implication of satisfaction) lovely; also (noun) a home, of God (temple), men (residence), flocks (pasture), or wild animals (den)

H5117.gloss: cease, be confederate, lay, let down, (be) quiet, remain, (cause to, be at, give, have, make to) rest, set down. Compare H3241 (יָנִים).
H5117.def: to rest, i.e. settle down; used in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, intransitive, transitive and causative (to dwell, stay, let fall, place, let alone, withdraw, give comfort, etc.)

H5125.def: to resprout, i.e. propagate by shoots; figuratively, to be perpetual

H5126.def: Nun or Non, the father of Joshua

H5127.gloss: [idiom] abate, away, be displayed, (make to) flee (away, -ing), put to flight, [idiom] hide, lift up a standard.
H5127.def: to flit, i.e. vanish away (subside, escape; causatively, chase, impel, deliver)

H5128.gloss: continually, fugitive, [idiom] make, to (go) up and down, be gone away, (be) move(-able, -d), be promoted, reel, remove, scatter, set, shake, sift, stagger, to and fro, be vagabond, wag, (make) wander (up and down).
H5128.def: to waver, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively (as subjoined)

H5129.def: Noadjah, the name of an Israelite, and a false prophetess

H5130.gloss: lift up, move, offer, perfume, send, shake, sift, strike, wave.
H5130.def: to quiver (i.e. vibrate up and down, or rock to and fro); used in a great variety of applications (including sprinkling, beckoning, rubbing, bastinadoing, sawing, waving, etc.)

H5132.def: properly, to flash; hence, to blossom (from the brilliancy of color); also, to fly away (from the quickness of motion)

H5133.def: a pinion (or wing feather); often (collectively) plumage

H5137.def: to spirt, i.e. besprinkle (especially in expiation)

H5139.gloss: Nazarite (by a false alliteration with Nazareth), separate(-d), vine undressed.
H5139.def: separate, i.e. consecrated (as prince, a Nazirite); hence (figuratively from the latter) an unpruned vine (like an unshorn Nazirite)

H5140.gloss: distil, drop, flood, (cause to) flow(-ing), gush out, melt, pour (down), running water, stream.
H5140.def: to drip, or shed by trickling

H5144.def: to hold aloof, i.e. (intransitivey) abstain (from food and drink, from impurity, and even from divine worship (i.e. apostatize)); specifically, to set apart (to sacred purposes), i.e. devote

H5145.def: properly, something set apart, i.e. (abstractly) dedication (of a priet or Nazirite); hence (concretely) unshorn locks; also (by implication) a chaplet (especially of royalty)

H5146.def: Noach, the patriarch of the flood

H5148.gloss: bestow, bring, govern, guide, lead (forth), put, straiten.
H5148.def: to guide; by implication, to transport (into exile, or as colonists)

H5152.def: Nochor, the name of the grandfather and a brother of Abraham

H5157.gloss: divide, have (inheritance), take as a heritage, (cause to, give to, make to) inherit, (distribute for, divide (for, for an, by), give for, have, leave for, take (for)) inheritance, (have in, cause to, be made to) possess(-ion).
H5157.def: to inherit (as a (figurative) mode of descent), or (generally) to occupy; causatively, to bequeath, or (generally) distribute, instate

H5158.def: a stream, especially a winter torrent; (by implication) a (narrow) valley (in which a brook runs); also a shaft (of a mine)

H5159.gloss: heritage, to inherit, inheritance, possession. Compare H5158 (נַחַל).
H5159.def: properly, something inherited, i.e. (abstractly) occupancy, or (concretely) an heirloom; generally an estate, patrimony or portion

H5160.def: Nachaliel, a place in the Desert

H5161.def: a Nechelamite, or descendant of Nechlam

H5162.def: properly, to sigh, i.e. breathe strongly; by implication, to be sorry, i.e. (in a favorable sense) to pity, console or (reflexively) rue; or (unfavorably) to avenge (oneself)

H5166.def: Nechemjah, the name of three Israelites

H5172.gloss: [idiom] certainly, divine, enchanter, (use) [idiom] enchantment, learn by experience, [idiom] indeed, diligently observe.
H5172.def: properly, to hiss, i.e. whisper a (magic) spell; generally, to prognosticate

H5176.def: Nachash, the name of two persons apparently non-Israelite

H5178.gloss: brasen, brass, chain, copper, fetter (of brass), filthiness, steel.
H5178.def: copper, hence, something made of that metal, i.e. coin, a fetter; figuratively, base (as compared with gold or silver)

H5180.def: something made of copper, i.e. the copper serpent of the Desert

H5181.gloss: be broken, (cause to) come down, enter, go down, press sore, settle, stick fast.
H5181.def: to sink, i.e. descend; causatively, to press or lead down

H5182.gloss: carry, come down, depose, lay up, place.
H5182.def: to descend; causatively, to bring away, deposit, depose

H5183.gloss: lighting down, quiet(-ness), to rest, be set on.
H5183.def: a descent, i.e. imposition, unfavorable (punishment) or favorable (food); restfulness

H5184.def: Nachath, the name of an Edomite and of two Israelites

H5186.gloss: [phrase] afternoon, apply, bow (down, -ing), carry aside, decline, deliver, extend, go down, be gone, incline, intend, lay, let down, offer, outstretched, overthrown, pervert, pitch, prolong, put away, shew, spread (out), stretch (forth, out), take (aside), turn (aside, away), wrest, cause to yield.
H5186.def: to stretch or spread out; by implication, to bend away (including moral deflection); used in a great variety of application

H5188.def: a pendant for the ears (especially of pearls)

H5190.def: to lift; by implication, to impose

H5193.def: properly, to strike in, i.e. fix; specifically, to plant (literally or figuratively)

H5194.def: a plant; collectively, a plantation; abstractly, a planting

H5197.def: to ooze, i.e. distil gradually; by implication, to fall in drops; figuratively, to speak by inspiration

H5198.def: a drop; specifically, an aromatic gum (probably stacte)
